# Pauseo

> Pauseo is a free iPhone app (iOS 17+, Polish and English) that helps people quitting or reducing smoking, vaping or nicotine get through the exact moment of a craving: one tap, one small action and 2 guided minutes of short prompts. After a slip it helps note the trigger without shame or "starting over". No account, no ads, no in-app purchases; all data stays on the phone. Launch on the App Store is planned for December 2026.

Pauseo is not a medical product: it gives no medical advice, does not suggest medication or nicotine-replacement doses, and does not replace a doctor or therapist.

## Key facts
- Category: craving support and micro-habit replacement for quitting smoking/vaping/nicotine
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later
- Languages: Polish, English
- Price: free; support in the moment of a craving is and will stay free
- Privacy: no account, no backend, no analytics or tracking; data stored locally on the device and deletable in the app
- Differentiator: helps in the moment of craving instead of counting days; a slip does not reset anything (counter of survived cravings never decreases)
- Contact: support@pauseo.app
